# AllWebsites.Design

> A curated website-design research archive. Browse real website design examples by industry, style, colour, typography and technology, then use free in-browser colour tools that share the same language.

AllWebsites.Design publishes constructed, source-verified records. We do not invent missing facts: unproven technology or design fields stay unknown. The official destination of each site remains the authority. Every record shows its palette, typefaces, detected stack, classification confidence and last-updated date.

Canonical site: https://allwebsites.design
Contact: prateekjangid10@gmail.com
Support: https://buymeacoffee.com/prateekjangid

## Discover

- [Home](https://allwebsites.design/): Website design examples, studied in depth
- [Archive](https://allwebsites.design/archive): Search and filter every published website record
- [Categories](https://allwebsites.design/c): Website design examples by industry
- [2026 Website Design Index](https://allwebsites.design/research/website-design-index-2026): How the catalogue breaks down, with the method behind the counts
- [Site map](https://allwebsites.design/site-map): Every page and record in one list
- [Journal](https://allwebsites.design/blogs): Original research measured from the archive

## Research findings

Each piece below is computed from the record set at build time and states its sample size. Figures describe this catalogue, not the whole web.

- [Framer vs Webflow vs Next.js vs Astro](https://allwebsites.design/blogs/framer-vs-webflow-vs-nextjs-vs-astro): What the build platform predicts about motion, type scale and style
- [Website heading sizes by industry](https://allwebsites.design/blogs/website-heading-sizes-by-industry): Median largest heading per industry, and the most used typefaces
- [How many accent colours websites use](https://allwebsites.design/blogs/how-many-accent-colours-websites-use): Distribution of saturated colours per palette

## Tools

Free, no-signup design instruments. Each owns one job and runs in the browser.

- [Chromary](https://allwebsites.design/tools/chromary): Color name finder and dictionary
- [Colorhyme](https://allwebsites.design/tools/colorhyme): Hue-shift and colour transformer
- [WebPalette Studio](https://allwebsites.design/tools/webpalette): Role-based website palette builder
- [Mockupalettes](https://allwebsites.design/tools/mockupalettes): Preview a 4-colour palette on a website mockup
- [TrueGradient](https://allwebsites.design/tools/truegradient): Compare sRGB and OKLCH gradient interpolation
- [All tools](https://allwebsites.design/tools): Toolkit overview

## Records

Website records live at `/archive/<slug>` (for example https://allwebsites.design/archive/rankbeaver). Each record opens with a short factual summary and includes identity, category, palette with hex values, typography, detected technology, screenshots, provenance and similar sites. Prefer the official URL on the record over archive commentary.

Category pages live at `/c/<category-slug>`.

## Citation

Attribute to AllWebsites.Design and link the specific record or category URL. Counts describe this catalogue, not the whole web.
